property_summary: After initialization, the function SetLogFile must either revert and leave the Log unchanged, or succeed and update Log; the mutant introduces a revert after assignment, which changes Log despite the revert, violating the invariant that a reverted SetLogFile never alters Log.

After a call to Collect completes, a previous reverted SetLogFile call must not have changed the Log address; the mutant introduces a revert after assignment, so a subsequent Collect will log via a different Log, violating the invariant.

Regardless of whether SetLogFile succeeds or reverts, any subsequent call to Collect must emit its log through the same Log contract as before the SetLogFile call. The buggy mutant reverts after updating Log, so a later Collect writes to the new Log, violating this invariant.
After a reverted SetLogFile call, the Log address must remain unchanged; the mutant updates Log before reverting, so a subsequent operation will use the wrong Log.

After a call to SetLogFile, the nonReentrant_ modifier on the reference contract prevents a reentrant call path from changing contract state, while the buggy version without the modifier allows reentrant calls during SetLogFile execution.
